title: Human Skin Single Cell Dissociation
author: James Fletcher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ripd4dn

steps.title: Trim skin into strips
steps.instruction: Cut skin into thin strips approximately 1.5 cm wide.

steps.title: Remove epidermal layer
steps.instruction: Using forceps, stretch the tissue and, with an 80 µm guard on a dermatome, cut off the top layer of skin; immediately place the cut sheet in ice‑cold PBS.

steps.title: Create mesh slits
steps.instruction: Cut a mesh of slits into the remaining ~200 µm skin layer to facilitate enzymatic access.

steps.title: Digest skin strips with Dispase
steps.instruction: Transfer the skin strips to a 50 mL Falcon tube containing RPMI supplemented with 2 U mL⁻¹ Dispase II; invert the tube to ensure reagent contacts all surfaces; seal with parafilm and incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 1 hour, inverting every 20 minutes.

steps.title: Dilute dispase
steps.instruction: Dunk the skin sheets in PBS to dilute the dispase.

steps.title: Separate epidermis and dermis
steps.instruction: Using fine forceps, peel the epidermis away from the dermis, placing each layer into separate containers of PBS on ice.

steps.title: Collagenase digestion of epidermis
steps.instruction: Transfer the epidermis to a cell‑culture dish containing 20 mL RF10 (RPMI + 10 % v/v FCS, 100 U mL⁻¹ Penicillin, 100 µg mL⁻¹ Streptomycin, 1 % v/v L‑Glutamine) and add type IV Collagenase to a final concentration of 1.6 mg mL⁻¹; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ overnight (~12 h).

steps.title: Collagenase digestion of dermis
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step using the dermis instead of the epidermis.

steps.title: Collect and filter cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Using a serological pipette, collect the supernatant from each dish, pass each through a 100 µm cell strainer, keeping epidermal and dermal fractions separate; then wash the base of each culture dish with RF10, collect the wash, and filter through a 100 µm strainer.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Combine the filtered cell suspensions, centrifuge at 500 g for 5 minutes with high acceleration/deceleration, discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in PBS, and proceed to cell counting.
